This '''town''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Bogg 4]]. Among the bustling streets of the town that were filled with various [[Species/Legends|species]] from all over the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] was a tavern called [[The Bonny Bounty]]. The young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] traveled to this town in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] in search of [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]], the man who hired his [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to be the [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].
